writeDomains.law: every domain below must have EXACTLY ONE owning lane in the round ownership proposal. A domain that must not be written in the round is declared no-write WITH A REASON; leaving it implicit is the defect this registry exists to prevent. noWriteExcept.why: the reference-lab law forbids product-application dependencies: every showroom surface except the DS reference lab is a post-DS integration consumer, not R1 canvas. Expressed as a supported root/allowed rule because the previous negative-lookahead glob was silently dropped by the matcher and therefore always passed.

noWriteExcept.scope: ONLY the exact schema-drift and geometry sentinels inside these three files. NOT the inherited artifact digests, NOT assertion strength, NOT any other compiler source or test.
noWriteExcept.why: Codex adjudication, 2026-08-05. The domain stays reserved for the reason originally given: the inherited worktree carries adjudicated prior-session compiler state that R1 must not disturb. Exactly three files are carved out because their pins are MECHANICAL CONSEQUENCES of writes in domains the architecture-integrator already owns. The recipe-profile registry lives in foundation/tokens/** and gained rottay/network-professional@1; the tenant-theme document schema PUBLISHES that registry as a closed enum, so both schema sentinels necessarily move. BitHire's expressive geometry moved sharp->rounded, so --ds-radius-scale necessarily moves 0.85 -> 1.25 in two brand-compiler pins. Leaving them red was unreachable against the owner instruction to return the Step 0 delta to the inherited failure baseline with no additional failures.
noWriteExcept.whyThisMechanism: Expressed through noWriteExcept rather than by deleting the no-write domain. noWrite fires when ANY lane claims the domain and therefore cannot express 'these three files and nothing else'; noWriteExcept fires per writeSet entry that falls outside the allowed roots. Because the root covers every compiler path, coverage is identical and any OTHER write under packages/core/src/infrastructure/compilers still blocks. No change was made to the checker itself.
noWriteExcept.authorityOrder: owner instruction -> DISC-01 raised as unresolved and NOT self-authorized -> Codex adjudication -> this executable amendment -> admission re-validation. The coordinator did not amend the contract to legalize its own write; it reported the conflict and the adjudicator resolved it.
noWriteExcept.verificationRequired: schema digests recomputed with an independent hasher, mutation and drift drills proven still failing, registry id proven permanent. Receipt: packages/core/test-artifacts/quality-evidence/wo-cra-23/R1/receipts/cohort-1-schema-digest-proof.json
